title: Fresh Food Letter Song
hook: Different foods can belong in different meals.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: clean 3D fresh-produce storybook, natural fruit and vegetable colors, simple white-and-green market setting, strong silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child observing dietary variety without moral labels
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: neutral produce fact, no medical claims
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: variety cue -> recall beat -> target -> color/shape card gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a warm guitar pluck plus small market-bell confirmation.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a warm guitar pluck plus small market-bell confirmation
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Healthy Produce into a nutrition-neutral variety song: fresh produce offers different plant compounds, fiber, water, vitamins/minerals, but no single item is labeled morally healthy/unhealthy and no medical claims are made.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child notices variety, plant families, texture and color while avoiding nutrient scorekeeping.
